correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 2x2 random update matrices and the induced 3x3 symmetric covariance map. Independent SymPy construction from tensor action shows det(I-L)+h F=0 identically and exact example F(1/10,7/4,3/11)=-315/3872 versus F(...,0)=9/160. Cone-preserving Perron root must cross 1 only at root F=0; small h contraction follows eigenvalue slope -2/(1-beta) while large h is unstable by repeated A0 event; F increases strictly with h. Optimization of F at fixed h over beta yields beta=(1-4p)h/4 when p<1/4, explaining unique tangent and explicit ceiling; at p>=1/4 optimum beta=0. Matrix proof is unbounded, numeric grid only supplements.

final_claim: For scalar iid Bernoulli fresh/one-step-stale heavy-ball iteration with p in (0,1), beta in [0,1), h>0, mean-square stability iff F=p h^2+[1+(4p-1)beta]h+2beta^2-2<0; unique maximum stable h across beta changes from beta>0 to beta=0 at p=1/4 with explicit formulas.
limitations: Only scalar quadratic, iid Bernoulli one-step read delays; no general Hessian, additive noise or convergence rate optimum.
residual_risks: Full Arjevani et al primary text inaccessible (authorized Oxford VPN disconnected), and stronger random switching literature might state equivalent momentum region.
The endpoint p=0 or beta=1 is excluded; stepsize ceiling is a strict unstable boundary, not an attained stable h.
